title: Fort Chaffee Arkansas Fueling System Repairs
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE ARMY.US ARMY CORPS OF ENGINEERS.ENGINEER DIVISION NORTHWESTERN.ENDIST OMAHA.W071 ENDIST OMAHA
detail_text: This project includes fuel system repairs at the Fort Chaffee retail and bulk fuel facilities. At the service station: Modify the three 8,000 gallon aboveground fuel storage tanks (AST?s) and appurtenances (including tank draining, cleaning, and disposal of any remaining product); Remove and dispose of three dispensers; Install three 12,000 gallon AST?s on new concrete pad; Repair dispensers (Two (2) diesel, One (1) MOGAS ) on new islands; Install offload point; Install parking hardstand area and spill containment system; AST work includes shut off valves, strapping charts, and catwalks; Install bollards; Repair emergency shut off system; Repair site lighting; Replace equipment building; Repair pavement. Construct a new steel framed canopy estimated to being 41.5 feet x 125 feet. Constructing new metal canopy construction and the associated foundation construction required. Foundation removal experience. At the bulk fuel facility: At the 3 AST?s provide catwalk, high level shut off, mechanical level gauge, water draw off, and strapping charts; Provide offload pumps, site flow indicator, offload meter Teflon pads, air eliminator, pressure relief valves, product recovery tanks, dispenser sumps; Replace fillstand pump, fuel piping, filter separator, undersized piping, threaded piping and valves, and dispensers; Install pipe supports; Remove transfer piping; Add level alarm; Repair pipe supports; Install bollards. All Contractors working at Fort Chaffee must be a licensed commercial contractor registered with the Contractors Licensing Board in Arkansas. Contractors will have experience installing brand new UL 2085 horizontal jet fuel (F-24) ASTs and installing meter proving connections.
